public_areas.name: Galleria Bellissima
public_areas.description: A 96-meter-long indoor Mediterranean-style promenade serving as the social axis of the ship. Lined with boutiques, specialty dining, cafes, bars, and duty-free retail shops.

public_areas.name: Galleria LED Dome Sky
public_areas.description: An 80-meter-long (480 m² / 5,170 sq ft) curved LED ceiling covering the central promenade. Acts as a digital sky transmitting sunrises, sunsets, dynamic atmospheres, and visual backdrops for parades and street shows.

public_areas.name: Swarovski Crystal Staircases
public_areas.description: Iconic multi-deck Atrium focal points. Features a total of 96 steps adorned with over 61,000 genuine Swarovski crystals.

public_areas.name: Top 19 Exclusive Solarium
public_areas.description: An adult-only, private sun deck containing premium sun loungers, whirlpools, and dedicated refreshments. Access restricted to Aurea Experience or premium package guests.

public_areas.name: Infinity Atrium & Reception
public_areas.description: The central 3-deck reception hub featuring Guest Relations, the Business Centre, live music lounge, and direct elevator access.
